CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold.category_breakdown AS
SELECT
    store_id,
    category,
    sale_date,
    SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales,
    SUM(quantity)      AS total_quantity
FROM silver.sales_clean
GROUP BY store_id, category, sale_date
